dashboard.byEngineSubtitle: Each AI assistant perceives your brand differently. Here's how their readings compare.
dashboard.competitiveEmpty: No assistant positioned your brand against competitors in this audit.
dashboard.quotesSubtitle: Verbatim answers from each engine, labeled by who generated them.
dashboard.cellFailed: This engine did not answer this question.
dashboard.analysisUnavailable: The engine answered, but our analysis couldn't be completed for this answer.

recommendation.presence: AI rarely mentions you. Publish canonical content and earn presence in the sources assistants cite (Wikipedia, press, reviews, and industry directories).
recommendation.accuracy: AI describes your brand inaccurately. Reinforce a clear, consistent canonical description on your site and across the sources AI consults.
recommendation.sentiment: AI's tone toward your brand is lukewarm or negative. Drive reviews, success stories, and visible testimonials that shape the narrative.
recommendation.competitive: Your competitors are positioned ahead of you. Differentiate your value proposition in comparative and category content.
recommendation.citation: AI doesn't cite your official site. Improve structured data, authority, and links to become a citable source.

dashboard.recommendationsPositive: Your brand has good visibility across every dimension. Keep content fresh and monitor how it evolves.
